finalists.label: Tumor-induced osteomalacia
finalists.why: The presence of a 9×8-mm intracortical lesion in the anterolateral right fibular head and elevated FGF23 level of 1241 RU/mL strongly support this diagnosis.

finalists.label: Osteomalacia
finalists.why: The patient's 2-year history of hip pain following low-impact falls, stress fractures, and elevated alkaline phosphatase level of 220 U/L are consistent with osteomalacia.

finalists.label: Hypophosphatasia
finalists.why: The elevated alkaline phosphatase level of 220 U/L and phosphorus level of 2.1 mg/dL could suggest hypophosphatasia, but the presence of elevated FGF23 level argues against it.

frontier_selector.why: The presence of a discrete bone lesion with high uptake on gallium-68 DOTATATE PET/MRI and markedly elevated FGF23 level are more specific for tumor-induced osteomalacia than for osteomalacia.
